signature: SUBROUTINE DPTCON( N, D, E, ANORM, RCOND, WORK, INFO )

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The n diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D from the factorization of A, as computed by DPTTRF.

params.name: e
params.reference: The (n-1) off-diagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal factor U or L from the factorization of A, as computed by DPTTRF.

params.name: anorm
params.reference: The 1-norm of the original matrix A.

params.name: rcond
params.reference: The reciprocal of the condition number of the matrix A, computed as $\mathrm{RCOND} = 1/(\mathrm{ANORM} \, \mathrm{AINVNM})$, where AINVNM is the 1-norm of inv(A) computed in this routine.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
